source: Bitcoin Core 32.1 (bitcoind -connect=0, offline): getdescriptorinfo for the checksum or the error, then deriveaddresses with range [0,11] on each branch of <0;1>. Made for the v2.18.0 review. Keys: the master xpub of BIP32 test vector 1 (origin aaaaaaaa), its m/0H xpub (cccccccc) and the master xpub of test vector 2 (bbbbbbbb), with made-up origins, and BIP341's unspendable key H. Cases with an error are ones Core refuses (the x_ cases are probes: x_lead0 and x_mixOr are ones Core accepts).
